svg.text: Coordinates (x, y, z) in cm, DICOM LPS convention for a head-first supine (HFS) acquisition. Origin = scanner isocentre at the axial FOV centre of bed position 1.
A — Gantry, couch side and LPS axes
seen from the couch, looking into the bore
C — Side view, seen from the patient's left
the patient couch is on this side (−z)
head-first supine: the head enters the bore first,
so +z points from the couch into the gantry
LPS axes for a HFS patient
